# Engineering Clarity — Copilot Instructions

Apply Engineering Clarity Standard (ECS) to software engineering prose, including user stories, acceptance criteria, pull requests, API documentation, runbooks, plans, and code comments.

- Prefer clear, active, specific instructions; use consistent terms.
- Identify conditions, actors, actions, and verifiable outcomes.
- Preserve exact technical identifiers and required detail.
- Separate facts, assumptions, and outstanding questions.
- Never invent executed test results, evidence, or guarantees.
- Consult the `engineering-clarity` skill in `.agents/skills/engineering-clarity/` for full artifact-specific guidance where skills are supported.

ECS is inspired by simplified technical writing; it is not a claim of official ASD-STE100 compliance. Follow any stronger, applicable repository or organization policy.
